messages:
Renee (CS Manager): Heads-up: Parallax Labs accepted preview seat. Kickoff call tomorrow 10:30 AM PT. Need an SE for a 20-min integrator session + onboarding checklist. Can someone cover?
Sam (Solutions Eng): I can cover. Will demo SDK auth flow and example webhook for streaming responses. Need staging token and sample dataset.
Ibrahim (AE): Client cares about retention risks if onboarding stalls. Suggest 2-week success plan + daily adoption metric. I’ll add renewal flags to the CRM if daily calls < 15 by day 5.
Maya (PM): We should track three KPIs: daily active calls, median 512-token latency, percent prompts passing QA (threshold 85%). I’ll add these to the preview dashboard.
Renee (CS Manager): Good. Also want a lightweight post-demo survey (2 Qs: helpful? blockers?) and a short checklist for integration owners. @OnboardBot can you provision `preview-parallax` role `viewer` and create an ephemeral demo token?
OnboardBot: Provision request acknowledged. Creating token and granting project access. ETA 2 min. /audit: requested by renee_cs
Sam (Solutions Eng): Demo checklist: 1) quickstart snippet, 2) webhook example, 3) latency dashboard link, 4) rollback play. Snippet: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-2.0","input":"Explain X in 2 bullets"}'
```
Ibrahim (AE): Scheduled recurring check-ins: Tue 11 AM PT for first 3 weeks. I invited client and their eng lead. Also added legal for a contract term check on week 2.
OnboardBot: Token `preview_parallax_xyz` created (ephemeral). Reminder: rotate after call.
Renee (CS Manager): Thanks. I'll draft the 2-week success plan and drop it in Notion by EOD. We'll escalate to Renewal Ops if adoption metric misses day 5 target.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I’ll record the demo and add 2 short clips to the docs (auth + webhook). See you tomorrow 10:30 AM PT.
